openclaw-proactive-agent v3.1.0 is a major update focused on proactive behavior, reliable memory, and self-improvement.

- Introduced "Verify Implementation, Not Intent" to emphasize checking mechanisms over descriptions.
- Added a Tool Migration Checklist to ensure proper updates when tools are deprecated.
- Enhanced documentation with detailed overviews of the WAL Protocol, Working Buffer, Compaction Recovery, and proactive agent philosophy.
- Expanded and updated security hardening guidance.
